notes: «فلقيت أبا معبد فسألته» is first person with no named reporter: the one who met Abu Mabad is implicit, so the chain has no written first link (rule 11)
«وقال خالد عن أبي عثمان عن مجاشع» gives another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route of the first
«فقال صدق مجاشع» is Abu Mabad's own remark; «صدق مجاشع» names Mujashi' in the saying, not as a link
